senses.en: To stop working because of age or choice.
senses.example: Mr. Lin will retire at the end of the year.

senses.en: A book of rules, instructions, or information.
senses.example: The employee handbook explains vacation policies.

senses.en: An experienced person who advises someone less experienced.
senses.example: Each trainee is paired with a mentor for six months.

senses.en: The quality of being attractive or interesting.
senses.example: The simple design gives the product broad appeal.

senses.en: A serious or formal request for help or action.
senses.example: The manager made an appeal for volunteers to join the project.

senses.en: An arrangement of products or information for people to see.
senses.example: The window display attracted many customers.

senses.en: Continued support for a person, brand, or organization.
senses.example: The store rewards customer loyalty with points.

senses.en: A journey by airplane.
senses.example: The flight to Seoul leaves at noon.

senses.en: A business that provides a particular service.
senses.example: The travel agency booked our tickets and hotel.

senses.en: To decide that a planned event or booking will not happen.
senses.example: The airline may cancel the flight because of bad weather.

senses.en: A record or profile that allows access to a service.
senses.example: Create an account before using the online platform.

senses.en: A formal explanation or description of events.
senses.example: Please give a full account of what happened during the meeting.

senses.en: To convert information into a secure coded form.
senses.example: The software will encrypt sensitive customer data.

senses.en: A system or service on which applications or activities run.
senses.example: The platform supports online training courses.

senses.en: A list of cargo or passengers on a vehicle or vessel.
senses.example: The manifest lists every item in the shipment.

senses.en: A situation in which there is not enough of something.
senses.example: A parts shortage delayed production for a week.

senses.en: The act or space used to keep goods safely.
senses.example: Cold storage is required for some food products.

senses.en: Money sent to someone in another place.
senses.example: The remittance arrived in the supplier's bank account.

senses.en: To give official permission for something.
senses.example: Only the account owner can authorize the transfer.

senses.en: A secure room or container for valuables.
senses.example: Important documents are stored in the bank vault.

senses.en: To carry out a plan or formally complete a legal document.
senses.example: The director will execute the agreement on Monday.

senses.en: Permission for something to happen.
senses.example: Written consent is required before sharing personal data.

senses.en: Official permission to do, use, or own something.
senses.example: The software license allows installation on five computers.

senses.en: The condition of being protected from danger.
senses.example: Safety training is required for all factory workers.

senses.en: An early model used to test a design.
senses.example: Engineers tested the prototype before mass production.

senses.en: A detailed description of requirements or design.
senses.example: The parts must meet the exact specification.
